description: A Notion database with one row per work item. The Status and Stage columns are select (or status) properties; every value in status_map must exist as an option in the database.
fetch: With the Notion connector, fetch the database at meta.tracker.target and query every row (follow pagination). Write a JSON list to a file with one object per row, keyed by this adapter's field names: Name (title), Status, Stage, Updated, Link.
